mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% needs our services. Their %STATION_NAME% is being attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%. Both groups of quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but have also learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. Each faction considers itself the true master of the Solar System.

An attack on the station can begin at any moment, and if we want to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Elimination1.afte: The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> were satisfied. Their gift for our obedience awaits us in the Magnum’s cargo hold.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Elimination1.brie: We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%. Don't take unnecessary risks, save your strength. I send the target location to your map. Good luck.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Elimination1.deta:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% captured %STATION_NAME%. The Shedu's Thousand wants to teach these rebels a lesson. The will of Gagtungr must be fulfilled. The Duke of %VICTIM_NAME% is currently located in this location. It is preparing quasimorphs to attack the stations captured by the Shedu's Thousand.

We eliminate the Duke, and Gagtungr will treat his new servants favorably, when he wakes up.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke</color> to safety at %STATION_NAME%. Quasimorphs will send the best warriors into battle, so be careful.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing to attack %STATION_NAME%. However, it has been turned into a real fortress by %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems it is planning to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The Quasimorphs call on their loyal servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard.

We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Escort1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Espionage1.after: The meeting with the operators of the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> took place. We gave them the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>, they gave us a worthy reward.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Espionage1.briefi:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend the igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Espionage1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %VICTIM_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. Operators of The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> told us that at %STATION_NAME% there is an <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> - a special mineral-like entity. The <color=#FFFEC1>Igvalite</color> is capable of accumulating gavvakh - energy that powers quasimorphs. If we want to serve the army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color>, we must get this mineral for it.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Espionage1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.aft: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.bri:
Several groups of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this stone.

How did we even get into this, Boss?
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.des: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.det:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has held %STATION_NAME% for a long time. However, it is now under attack from %VICTIM_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an Igvalite coming from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can eliminate the groups of quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% who have come for the igvalite. Let's do this, and the reward from the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely high.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.obj: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.af: Soldiers of the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> settle in %STATION_NAME%. They are pleased with our success. Soon <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> will awaken and turn his benevolent gaze on us. Something extremely valuable has already been transferred to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.br:
We don't know how some quasimorphs remain in our reality, while the majority are always attracted by their bramfaturas. I want to say that %STATION_NAME% is simply teeming with warriors of %VICTIM_NAME%. Sensors show that they are aware of the attack and are waiting for your arrival.

Proceed methodically, do not take unnecessary risks. Kill enough and the survivors will run. At the end of the mission, as soon as you leave the facility, the Shedu's Thousand will send its duke.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_RaiderCapture1.de:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand appeared here to return the Solar System to Gagtungr. Now the warriors of Urparp are looking for anyone who will capture %STATION_NAME% for them in order to turn this place into another bastion of the future Golden Empire. It is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. These upstarts must be expelled from physical reality forever.

We will crush them, and Gagtungr will turn his attention to us.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.after:
The quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% at %STATION_NAME% resemble bees in a disturbed hive. The time will soon come to strike here again.

The Shedu's Thousand is extremely pleased with our work. We received a valuable gift from her for our work.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.briefin: What the sensors are showing is impossible to believe. These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they are literally shining! %STATION_NAME% is swarming with quasimorphs. Show the %VICTIM_NAME% faction how humans fight. Let us prove our usefulness to <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color>.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.details:
Details: Soldiers of the Shedu’s Thousand have partially lifted the veil of mystery surrounding how quasimorphs linger in physical reality. They have learned to bind their energy to a special reliquary that serves as another object of worship. Somehow, the quasimorphic faction %VICTIM_NAME% has also come into possession of this secret.

At the station they control, %STATION_NAME%, there are reliquaries that grant them the ability to remain in our world. We can demonstrate our importance to the Shedu’s Thousand if we destroy these artifacts.
mission.Shedu_Tezctlan_Sabotage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color> — quasimorphic artifacts resembling a statue or an obelisk.
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Control1.after: The meeting with %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Control1.briefing: %VICTIM_NAME% is already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% has long been waging war against its quasimorphic enemies and is ready to attack %STATION_NAME%. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Control1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? And is it worth doing this for the sake of other quasimorphs?
mission.Shedu_Xiomara_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that hostile quasimorphs have already appeared in certain areas of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.

Details: Enemies of Gagtungr, which are much more dangerous than people, have appeared in the Solar System. Yes, Gagtungr is sleeping, but the time for his awakening is near, and the Shedu's Thousand must prepare everything.

%STATION_NAME% is located in in the hands of the rebel %VICTIM_NAME%. These upstarts must be forever expelled from physical reality, which will become an inexhaustible source of gavvakh only for the true master of the Solar System.

mission.Shedu.names: Doom of Anunnaki;Song of Enlil;Seal of Nergal;Shadow of Kur;Gate of Eridu;Wrath of Enki;Call of Ereshkigal;Eye of Shummuramat;Serpents of Anzu;Burden of Izmu;War of Gudsah;Presence of Zahra;Dream of Pshutu;Box of Aiyar;Cry of Veltahur;Aklo's Glove;Sheid's Poison;Om-Uru's Melody;Mask of Tiamat;Whisper of Abzu
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Defense1.brief: <color=#FFFEC1>The Civil Resistance</color> colnodes have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold your defense</color> until the enemies retreat.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Defense1.detai: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is evidence that the appearance of the Solar System has changed forever. But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Elimination1.a:
The Master is pleased with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

Tezctlan gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum by his servants.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Elimination1.b: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %VICTIM_NAME% is using countermeasures on %STATION_NAME%, so we have to maneuver. Sensors show that personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Carry out a massacre, but get to the <color=#FFFEC1>commander</color> of these psychos. The will of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is clearer than ever.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Elimination1.d: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> joined the fight for the Solar System. He perceives all people as an annoying obstacle to building an Empire. Now the piercing gaze of <color=#FFFEC1>the King of Gannix</color> is directed towards %STATION_NAME%, which is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> says that there is a factor there that prevents the capture of this place. He speaks of "a great warrior defending a place of power." Our analysts studied the station and came to the conclusion that we are talking about the commander of the station’s defense. The Master will be extremely pleased if we eliminate this warrior.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Tezctlan_CivilRes_Escort1.briefi: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific <color=#FFFEC1>task</color>: to escort the Duke to safety at %STATION_NAME%. You should easily deal with the militants of %VICTIM_NAME%.
